scores.claim_text: BWXT Nuclear Operations Group supplies sole-source naval nuclear reactors / fuel to U.S. Navy via DOE/NNSA Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program ($1,622.6M FY2021 NOG revenue, 76% of consolidated revenue from U.S. Government).
supports: usaspending shows BWXT-family entities received ~$23.4B in DOE awards (37 awards), including BWXT Y-12 LLC ($10.99B), BWXT Pantex LLC ($6.57B), Fluor-BWXT Portsmouth LLC ($4.47B), BWXT Nuclear Operations Group HALEU processing $79.8M, NFS $280.9M.

BWXT NOG ranked as sole-source supplier of naval nuclear reactors is consistent with $80M+ direct DOE award stream and historical industrial structure (DOE/NNSA's Naval Reactors program funded under separate appropriation, not in J-Book DoD corpus).
scores.M_value: pentagon_jbook=NOT_FOUND; doe_budget=NOT_FOUND; usaspending: 37 awards, $23.38B total, top recipients BWXT Y-12 / BWXT Pantex / Fluor-BWXT Portsmouth / BWXT NOG
scores.interpretation: Naval Nuclear Propulsion is funded by NNSA/DOE under the Naval Reactors program (NOT a J-Book DoD PE) and is outside both corpora. Per Heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND is UNVERIFIABLE not red flag; but the orthogonal USAspending crosscheck strongly CONFIRMS the claim ($23B+ in DOE awards across BWXT entities). The forward narrative is supported by real, sticky DOE/NNSA contract base. PASS.

scores.claim_text: BWXT performs fabrication of missile launch tubes for U.S. Navy submarines (Columbia SSBN / Virginia SSN Common Missile Compartment exposure).
supports: J-Book corpus does not contain Columbia/Virginia/Common Missile Compartment/Trident entries (these are Navy SCN — Shipbuilding & Conversion Navy — and Trident II is OPN/WPN, generally not in our RDT&E-heavy 410-PE corpus).

USAspending DoD search did not surface submarine launch tube subcontracts to BWXT directly — typical industry structure has GD-EB / HII-NNS as prime, BWXT as deep-tier supplier (subcontract obligations not visible at prime-recipient level).
scores.M_check: pentagon_jbook.query_program_funding(Columbia class / Virginia class / Common Missile Compartment / Trident / Trident II)
scores.interpretation: Corpus gap (Heuristic 7). The Columbia and Virginia programs are well-known POR; absence from this corpus reflects corpus scope (RDT&E PEs), not program health. Cannot verify divergence from public sources; flag as UNVERIFIABLE with note that publicly Columbia and Virginia are full-rate procurement priorities.

scores.claim_text: BWXT's forward growth narrative is tied to U.S. Navy's FY2022 long-range shipbuilding plan (increase fleet of submarines and aircraft carriers); BWXT made capex/personnel investments to meet this growth.
supports: Shipbuilding plans / Ford-class CVN / general shipbuilding line items are not in this J-Book corpus (corpus is RDT&E + select Procurement PEs).
FY22 long-range shipbuilding plan is a Navy planning document, not a single PE that can be looked up; structurally outside the framework's coverage.
scores.M_check: pentagon_jbook.query_program_funding(shipbuilding / Ford class aircraft carrier / aircraft carrier / CVN-80)
scores.interpretation: Narrative is forward-looking and tied to a planning document, not a single PE. Outside corpus scope. UNVERIFIABLE. No basis to mark as underdelivery; large segment backlog ($4.5B) confirms forward bookings exist.

scores.claim_text: BWXT received $2.2B combined contract awards from U.S. Government in March 2021; ~$0.4B of unexercised options expected through 2024.
supports: usaspending.query_recipient_contracts(BWXT) returns 37 awards / $23.38B total with the major awards (Y-12 M&O, Pantex M&O, Portsmouth D&D, HALEU) clearly multi-billion / multi-year and consistent with the disclosed cadence.
BWXT NOG specifically holds DOE awards including HALEU processing $79.8M and NFS uranium purification/conversion $210M+ — these are exactly the types of multi-year awards the company described.
scores.M_value: 37 contracts totaling $23.38B; DoD direct contracts $36.9M (BWXT Ordnance Tennessee depleted uranium penetrators for M829A4)
scores.interpretation: USAspending strongly confirms BWXT's claimed contract base. Naval Reactors funding flows through NNSA/DOE rather than DoD J-Book, which explains low DoD direct totals; the BWXT Ordnance Tennessee DoD contracts (DU penetrators) are a small ancillary line. The disclosed contract narrative is corroborated. PASS.

summary.thesis_note: BWXT's revenue model is structurally outside the J-Book DoD divergence framework: ~76% of revenue flows from NNSA/DOE Naval Reactors program (Naval Nuclear Propulsion) and DOE Environmental Management M&O contracts (Y-12, Pantex, Portsmouth), not from named DoD Pentagon Program Elements. The J-Book divergence pattern (defense contractors riding named DoD PEs that the Pentagon is zeroing) does not fit this issuer. Orthogonal USAspending evidence STRONGLY corroborates the disclosed contract base ($23.4B across 37 BWXT-family awards). EPA FRS independently corroborates the disclosed manufacturing footprint. Per Heuristic 7, the J-Book NOT_FOUND signals are corpus-scope artifacts, not red flags. No SEVERE/RED triggers.
